import json
from collections import Counter
cs=[json.loads(l) for l in open('items.jsonl')];rs=[json.loads(l) for l in open('answers.jsonl')]
rs[36]['letters']='n';rs[36]['errors'].insert(0,'missing_word_or_span')
rs[47]['owner_crop']['turned_or_clipped']='yes';rs[47]['segmentation_detail']='The complete two-digit number is turned approximately 90 degrees.'
rs[48].update(marks='n',errors=['extra_mark'],detail='Οψεως → Όψεως')
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for r in rs:f.write(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
assert len(rs)==len(cs)
assert [r['card_id'] for r in rs]==[c['card_id'] for c in cs]
assert len({r['card_id'] for r in rs})==len(rs)
for r in rs:
 assert all(k in r for k in ['card_id','letters','marks','crop_ok','errors','detail','owner_crop','where'])
 assert r['letters'] in ['y','n','u'] and r['marks'] in ['y','n','na'] and r['crop_ok'] in ['y','n']
 assert len(r['owner_crop'])==5 and all(x in ['yes','no','uncertain'] for x in r['owner_crop'].values())
print('Cards:',len(rs),'Count and order: verified')
for k in ['letters','marks','crop_ok']:print(k,dict(Counter(r[k] for r in rs)))
print('Errors:',Counter(e for r in rs for e in r['errors']).most_common())
